title: 第2409章 不受影响第2408章 星辉城晋级
content_zh:
第2409章不受影响
踩在太阴血冰上，江平安并未像其他参赛者那样受到了影响。
倒也不是说没影响，只是影响很小。
寒气进入体内后，立刻就被无极之力吸收了。
其他人为了对抗太阴血冰和重力，体力和神力快速消耗。
可江平安体内的能量不仅没有消耗，反而在增加！
“太阴血冰……太阴之力……是因为这个原因吗？”
太阴，极致的阴属性力量。
在神域的范围内，太阴太阳，同样是极强的规则力量。
比秩序神界的太阴太阳的等级更高。
江平安以前就拥有阴阳道体，后来转化为了无极道体。
可能是因为他的无极道体的原因，他能吸收太阴血冰散发出来的极阴之力，转化为自己的力量。
随着众多弟子接触台阶的时间增长，他们双脚上渐渐覆盖上了寒冰，行动和速度受到了影响。
江平安为了不引人注意，便减缓吸收太阴血冰的力量，也让自己的双脚上结冰。
在这种天才遍地的地方，不能让自己表现得太特殊。
反正能在三个时辰登上山巅就行。
“扑通！”
一名在前面向上攀登的弟子，一个不小心，摔在了台阶上。
“我的双腿都冻僵了！这太阴血冰太霸道了，进入体内就会冻结血液和经脉，根本挡不住！！”
他身上涌出大量灼热的火焰，试图融合冰块，但效果微乎其微。

冻结的血液不断向着身体上方蔓延。
其他参赛者见状，根本不敢停，加速向上攀登。
然而，越是往上，重力就越强。
恐怖的重力压力降临在身上，众人速度不断减缓。
山巅明明就在眼前，可却让这群参赛者感觉无比遥远。
江平安跟在人群后面减缓速度。
在其他人全神贯注的攀登时，他在走神思考其他事情。
“结束第二场考核，我就能拿到累计三百亿圣地币和三次免费听课的机会。”
“三百亿圣地币应该怎么花呢？肯定要买一些养魂液，供给神魂养料，加速参悟规则。”
“剩下的钱，看情况而定，如果能剩下一些，就购买道果丹，提前为突破中位主神做准备。”
“对了，还有一件事，是关于外出执行任务的事情。”
content_en:
Chapter 2409 Not Affected
Stepping on Taiyin Blood Ice, Jiang Pingan was not affected like other contestants.
That’s not to say there is no impact, but the impact is very small.
After the cold air entered the body, it was immediately absorbed by Wuji's power.
In order to fight against the Taiyin blood ice and gravity, others' physical strength and divine power were quickly depleted.
But the energy in Jiang Pingan's body is not only not consumed, but is increasing!
"Taiyin Blood Ice...the power of Taiyin...is this the reason?"
Taiyin, the ultimate Yin attribute power.
Within the scope of the divine realm, the lunar sun is also a very powerful power of regulation.
It has a higher level than the Taiyin and Sun of the Order God Realm.
Jiang Pingan had possessed the Yin-Yang Taoist body before, but later transformed into the Wuji Taoist body.
Perhaps because of his Wuji Dao body, he can absorb the extremely yin power emitted by Taiyin Blood Ice and transform it into his own power.
As the time that many disciples have been in contact with the steps increases, their feet are gradually covered with ice, and their movement and speed are affected.
In order not to attract attention, Jiang Ping'an slowed down the power of absorbing Taiyin blood ice and allowed ice to form on his feet.
In a place like this where geniuses abound, you can't let yourself act too special.
Anyway, as long as we can reach the top of the mountain in three hours.
"Plop!"
A disciple who was climbing up in front accidentally fell on the steps.
"My legs are frozen! This Taiyin Blood Ice is so overbearing, it will freeze the blood and meridians when it enters the body, and it can't be stopped at all!!"
A large amount of scorching flames surged out of his body, trying to fuse with the ice, but the effect was minimal.
The frozen blood continued to spread upwards to the body.
Seeing this, the other contestants did not dare to stop and accelerated their climb.
However, the higher you go up, the stronger the gravity becomes.
The terrifying gravity pressure came on them, and everyone's speed continued to slow down.
The top of the mountain is clearly right in front of us, but it makes these contestants feel extremely far away.
Jiang Pingan followed the crowd and slowed down.
While others were concentrating on the climb, he was distracted and thinking about other things.
"After the second assessment, I will get a total of 30 billion holy land coins and three free lectures."
"How should we spend the 30 billion Holy Land coins? We must buy some soul nourishing liquid to provide nourishment for the soul and speed up the understanding of the rules."
"The remaining money depends on the situation. If you can have some left, buy the Dao Fruit Pill and prepare in advance to break through to the middle god."
"By the way, there is one more thing, about going out on a mission."
